glossary.definition: A mixture-of-experts model is built from many smaller specialized sub-networks, and for any given question it only activates the few most relevant ones instead of running the entire model every time. It works like a hospital: when you walk in with a broken arm, the whole staff doesn't examine you, you get routed to the orthopedist. That routing means very large AI models can stay affordable to run, since most of the model stays idle for any single request.

items.title: HCLTech Launches NVIDIA-Powered Validation Offering for Software-Defined Vehicles
items.summary: HCLTech has launched an AI-powered verification and validation (V&V) offering for automotive software, built on NVIDIA’s simulation technologies and AI models. The offering targets vehicle manufacturers and tier-1 suppliers developing software-defined vehicles . The offering links requirements, test creation and execution, failure analysis, and compliance reporting across the validation process. The company identified fragmented toolchains, manual testing workflows and labour-intensive compliance processes as challenges in validating increasingly complex vehicle software, particularly as automakers roll out over-the-air updates.

items.title: OpenAI agents analyze mouse brain data in 32 minutes, a job that would take humans months
items.summary: OpenAI teamed up with PerturbAI and Scripps Research to deploy thousands of AI agents that analyzed biological data from millions of mouse cells. According to OpenAI , the agents ran on GPT-Rosalind and worked through a whole-brain CRISPR atlas, which maps how gene changes affect different cell types in the mouse brain. The full analysis took 32 minutes. Each agent took on a single gene perturbation, analyzed how the cells responded, and searched the scientific literature for explanations.

items.title: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
items.summary: The new open-source model speaks the language of DNA and can help researchers understand the effects of any changes on gene activity and health. The AI platform Hugging Face on Thursday released a new open-source model for understanding DNA that can run locally on a laptop. Developed in collaboration with researchers at Zhongguancun Academy in China and the University of Naples Federico II in Italy, the model is trained on genomic sequences and natural language so that people can ask questions about the effects of DNA changes on gene activity and health and get conversational answers in return. Lewis Tunstall, a senior research scientist at Hugging Face, says the tool is meant to help researchers design new drugs and genetic therapies, and it could potentially aid patients in interpreting their own genomes.

items.title: Making the case for context-aware AI
items.summary: Enterprise AI can generate recommendations, automate tasks, and help organizations make decisions faster. But without an understanding of how a business actually operates, even powerful models can miss the constraints and relationships that determine whether a decision is the right one. As companies look to move AI from experimentation into everyday operations, the challenge ahead is giving technology the context to act usefully within complex business processes. ” AI agents can support individual tasks within larger decision-making processes, he argues, but they need to understand the role each task plays and the business conditions surrounding it.

items.title: Why reasoning models should not have to read everything
items.summary: The AI industry has been expanding how much information an AI model can consume at once. In just a few years, context windows have grown from thousands of tokens to millions. Anthropic increased Claude’s context window from 9,000 to 100,000 tokens in May 2023 , reaching 200,000 tokens by November 2023 . Google’s Gemini 1.5 Pro reached one million tokens in February 2024 , then two million by June 2024 .

items.title: OpenAI to make its most advanced AI models available in Google Cloud
items.summary: OpenAI Group PBC today announced plans to make its latest large language models accessible in Google Cloud. ’s unit Model Garden service. It provides access to more than 200 neural networks from Google, its partners and the open-source ecosystem. The lineup includes not only LLMs but also smaller, more specialized models optimized for tasks such as translation.

items.title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
items.summary: Blackstone’s AI head on why the PE giant isn't panicked by market jitters. Private equity giant Blackstone is putting itself at the center of the AI boom, firm veteran Jas Khaira discussed last week on stage at TechCrunch Disrupt. It is writing checks via various strategies, ranging from offering massive loans to data centers to investing in frontier AI models and applications. Earlier this year, the firm launched Blackstone N1 (BXN1), a San Francisco-based central hub for its AI initiatives.

items.title: Data centers could erase decades of air quality gains
items.summary: A rush of new data centers could bring air pollution roaring back to levels not seen since the 2000s in Texas, which has become ground zero for the physical infrastructure behind generative AI. New and proposed data centers are demanding a tremendous amount of electricity. How developers and utilities meet that demand - with gas turbines or renewable energy - will determine just how dirty things will get. So far, though, things are looking grim.

items.title: Reach new heights of laziness by burning tokens to let an AI tap your smartphone screen for you
items.summary: Why use your smartphone when AI can do it for you? We’ve reached a new level of AI inanity with the launch of Opposable, a tool that taps, swipes, and types on Android phones and controls iPhones through a companion computer, sparing users the apparent burden of operating their own devices. If you don't want to update a calendar event, start a timer, or enable dark mode, you can apparently use an AI agent app on your computer (any client that supports MCP will do) to have Opposable do the thing for you on a connected phone. You could just do it on your computer, of course, but that’d require actually using your hands - like it’s some sort of baby’s toy.

items.title: The new human-crafted Apple Music brand matters in an AI world
items.summary: Apple just revealed a new brand identity for Apple Music, with the expected turn to Liquid Glass. I’m not much of a fan of their new design language in general; this is where I admit that I’m still running MacOS Sequoia and have grumpy things to say about rounded corner radii and text legibility. It’s just a trend, it will pass, and at some point I’ll probably cave and upgrade when it starts actually affecting my ability to get work done, or more importantly get security updates. Once I adjust, I’ll stop noticing it, and life will go on.

items.title: Remediation in the era of AI: Fix what matters first
items.summary: Every IT and security team knows the feeling of opening a vulnerability report and seeing a number that only goes up. Thousands of findings. Hundreds marked critical. A backlog that grows faster than any team can close it. For years, the default response has been to work harder: more scans, more tickets, more overtime.

items.title: How payroll giant ADP practices AI governance and human oversight
items.summary: The governance approach focuses on key principles of transparency, explainability, risk management, privacy and security.
